entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: The stage is set.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you. I appreciate it, but...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I know. You're not going to be[n]my right-hand man, right? Don't[n]worry, I won't pull any tricks.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Feel free to talk about being falsely accused.[n]I'll handle whatever comes from it.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I saw Kuramoto's grandson around[n]here somewhere. I bet he's curious[n]about today's speech.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I haven't spoken to him since we last met.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: This speech should serve as[n]your response to him.

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: I didn't think any of the parties[n]would back No-Good Tora.

entries.speaker: Another Man's Voice
entries.en: He's going to talk about[n]the Phantom Thieves, right?

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: I couldn't care less about him.[n]I'm just interested in hearing[n]about the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Okay, I'm going to get started.
Do your best.[clr 27]
Break a leg.
I'm getting nervous.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I will. Especially with you looking on.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Will do.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha, same here.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm sure you're all aware of the[n]Phantom Thieves and their alleged[n]connection to recent incidents.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: What are you doing, Toranosuke...?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Setting aside whether their[n]actions are right or wrong...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: The reason they're causing[n]such a stir is because they are[n]addressing the world's problems.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: What are you doing, Toranosuke...?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Setting aside whether their[n]actions are right or wrong...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: There is one thing I can safely[n]say about the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: A belief with conviction...[n]has the ability to move[n]a person's heart.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm sure you are all aware that[n]I am "No-Good Tora," the one[n]accused of embezzlement.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I was a fool twenty years ago. It's[n]no wonder that I was considered[n]a failure as a politician.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: However, because I was accused like[n]that, I was able to understand the[n]suffering of the weak.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Why am I in politics? In the past,[n]it was merely for personal gain.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: But why do the Phantom Thieves[n]continue to change hearts?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I believe they do it for[n]the world and its people.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: And in choosing to do justice for[n]others, they had no choice but to[n]disguise themselves.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: No matter what the world[n]says, I fully support them.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm just an average citizen. However,[n]I will continue to voice my beliefs.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I may not be able to become[n]a Diet member this election...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: And I may not be able to effect[n]change during my lifetime...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: But I've made my peace with that.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I will be happy, as long as I can be[n]a meaningful stepping stone for[n]the future of our youth!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you for listening.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: ...I set the stage for nothing.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: So you have no intention of[n]accusing old man Kuramoto?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Sheesh... such a heartfelt speech for[n]someone your age.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: People are probably laughing at[n]you as we speak. I doubt any of[n]them were moved by your words.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: ...I might be the only one in[n]this entire city who was.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Matsushita...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Proceed as you wish with your[n]candidacy. I'll take measures to[n]ensure the party backs you.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Within the limits of my abilities, of course.[n]...Goodbye.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: My candidacy... huh? What an[n]unexpected turn of events.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Perhaps, it's the effect of[n]you moving my heart.
What are you talking about?
You had a change of heart.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: You have a bright future ahead of[n]you as a Diet member.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm sure you'll be able to[n]stay composed when the[n]opposition taunts you.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That must be it. Still, I have[n]you to thank for all this.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Yes, you're right.[n]There's no need for words.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Or have I given so many speeches[n]that my stories bore you now?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves... The power to[n]change a person's heart...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I don't possess a special power like[n]they do, but I won't lose to them[n]when it comes to conviction.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Speech is my only weapon. [n]Just my voice and my words.[n]That's how I win people over.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Thank you for sticking by[n]my side, [lName]-kun.
I feel like my bond with[n]Yoshida is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Contrary to what I thought,[n]getting your heart stolen[n]isn't such a bad thing.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: If he's a member of the[n]Phantom Thieves, then...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Ah, I'm talking to myself again.[n]Another bad habit of mine.[n]Time to finish up for today.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Good job.
